description: Boolean and list value parsing. Boolean options accept several truthy and falsy spellings: bare presence, `=true`/`=false`, `=1`/`=0`, and absence with an explicit default. List-valued options split a single comma-delimited argument into multiple typed elements. A boolean option absent from the command line and lacking an explicit default reports as false with a count of zero.

cases.expected_output:
count[bool]=1
value[bool]=false
value[debug]=true
value[timing]=true
value[verbose]=true
value[dry-run]=false
value[noExplicitDefault]=false
value[defaultTrue]=true
value[defaultFalse]=false
count[others]=1
